This local textbook bundles Pyodide 314.0.7, including its WebAssembly Python runtime,
and Marked 17.0.1. Pyodide is distributed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
Python uses the Python Software Foundation license and associated notices.
Marked is distributed under its MIT license. See licenses/ for included texts.
Upstream projects: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide and https://github.com/markedjs/marked.
The Pyodide package's pyodide-lock.json lists its runtime components.
